title: Koska Reeves
subtitle: Mandalorian
description: Koska Reeves was part of Bo-Katan Kryze's Clan Kryze group of Mandalorians, working with her to help reunite Bo-Katan with the Darksaber after Moff Gideon had taken it. Eventually, she drifted away and became a mercenary under the command of Axe Woves, but found her way back into Bo-Katan's service in time to unite with The Mandalorian Din Djarin's covert and take back Mandalore.
